messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: streaming-sse p99 chunk latency exceeded SLO (p99 ~ 18s, target 2s). Affected: eu-west-1 SSE and websocket proxies. Automated throttle did not resolve. Autoescalate to oncall.

emma: on it. grabbing context. @raj @maria can you stand by? I'll take lead for initial triage. :eyes:

raj: seeing uptick in 502/timeouts from streaming-proxy-7 in eu-west-1. Logs show repeated write timeouts to client sockets and large pending write buffers.

maria: looks like client-side backpressure causing proxy queues to grow, then kernel-level send buffer full -> proxy times out clients. p95 up too but p99 is brutal. Customers with long-lived streams worst.

jordan: any recent deploys? I see a config push to streaming-proxy this morning (keepalive tweak + chunk coalescing). @lena can you check deployment history?

lena: that deploy hit eu-west canary at 07:12UTC, rolled at 07:25. Rollout logs: streaming-proxy v3.4.1 with chunk_coalesce=true and write_batch_ms=20

emma: ok do we have metrics around chunk size distribution and write wait time? query:

emma: ```
# prometheus
sum(rate(streaming_proxy_outbound_write_wait_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)
``` 

raj: running a quick p95/p99 on request sizes + blocked_time. result: blocked_time.p99 = 17.8s, blocked_time.p95 = 2.1s. chunk_size.p50=512B, p90=4KB, p99=64KB (coalescing seems to increase occasional large chunks)

maria: hypothesis: coalescing increases occasional large writes that hit slow consumer clients, causing kernel buffer buildup and eventual proxy-level timeouts. Clients that cannot drain quickly cause head-of-line stalls for entire connection pool.

emma: mitigation plan:
1) rollback chunk_coalesce flag to false on eu-west proxies (immediate)
2) temporarily lower keepalive timeout to reduce stuck sockets
3) enable proxy-level slow-client shedding for streams > 10s write wait
4) route new connections to healthy region (fallback) for impacted customers

emma: executing rollback now. `kubectl set env deploy/streaming-proxy CHUNK_COALESCE=false -n prod` :running:

jordan: rolling back on eu-west-1, 4 pods updated. monitoring.

ops-bot: Deploy event: streaming-proxy CHUNK_COALESCE set to false by emma at 2026-03-15T07:47:10Z

lena: after rollback p95 write wait -> 1.9s, p99 -> 2.3s in eu-west (improvement but still slightly above SLO). Some residual sockets remain in ESTABLISHED state with send queues.

raj: I pushed an emergency config to enable slow-client-shed threshold: `STREAM_SLOW_SHED_MS=10000` on proxies. That will gracefully close connections that have >10s write wait after attempt to send heartbeat chunk.

maria: also flipped proxy TCP_QUICKACK tweak off (reduces kernel coalescing) and restarted pods 1 by 1.

emma: customer impact: estimated 43 customers had degraded streamed chunks, some ended up with full stream resets. Noted that persistent customers with mobile clients most affected. @support please prepare status note.

jordan: starting customer-impact query: `select customer_id, count(*) from stream_errors where region='eu-west-1' and type in ('timeout','reset') group by customer_id` -> 43 customers, top 5 account for 78% of errors.

lena: paging PG on call to contact customers for impacted SLAs. prep message with recommended mitigations (switch to polling/short-lived sessions) until stable.

emma: temporary fallback: set route policy to non-stream mode for top 5 impacted customers so they get full response instead of streaming. Doing that via runtime route override.

ops-bot: Route override applied for customer IDs [123,456,789,101,112] -> non-stream mode at 07:55UTC

maria: monitoring shows tail p99 dropping to ~1.8s after slow-shed + overrides. write buffers clearing.

raj: captured tcpdump from one stuck connection: shows client not ACKing after large chunk. probable flaky mobile network + chunk size spike. snippet:

raj: ```
# tcpdump summary
07:31:12.123 IP proxy->client PSH Seq=... Len=65536
07:31:12.130 IP client->proxy ACK Seq=... Len=0
07:31:29.500 IP proxy->client PSH Seq=... Len=65536
# no ACKs for second chunk until 07:31:46
```

emma: root cause: interaction of chunk coalescing + aggressive write batching caused occasional >64KB writes that slow clients couldn't ACK quickly, leading to proxy send buffers filling, timeouts, and global connection stalls.

jordan: action items:
- infra: add a max_chunk_size limit to proxy to avoid >16KB single writes (raj)
- runtime: add per-connection backpressure metric and early-shed flag (maria)
- devex: update rollout checklist to include load testing with slow consumer emulation (emma)
- support: outbound customer notifications and incident page (lena)

raj: created PR #932: proxy: enforce max_chunk_bytes=16384 with immediate flush if exceeded. will cherry-pick to v3.4.

maria: filed monitoring rule: alert if streaming_conn_slow_clients_ratio > 0.02 for 5m in any region.

lena: drafted customer note, staging for send after legal review. No P1 status required for now, we mark Sev2 impact on streaming SLOs.

emma: thanks all. leaving follow-up items in incident board. I'll hand back to oncall rotation. @jordan you take post-incident review and timeline.

jordan: taking it. I'll post a brief RCA and timeline in #postmortems tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Incident closed to active triage at 08:15UTC. Final p99 ~1.6s, p95 within target. Logs archived.

maria: notes: consider adding client pacing guidance in SDK doc to avoid large writes from server side.

emma: 👍 good work. moving to monitoring watch for next 24h. :coffee:
